qualifier: serotypes A, B and E
name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotypes A, B and E toxicity
rationale: All members are Reactome toxicity pathways of botulinum toxins A, B and E, distinguishing the theme from the C, D, G serotypes and from cholinergic transmission or vesicle release cycle neighbours.

qualifier: with translation factor and peptidyl residue modification (hypusine, diphthamide, hydroxylation)
name: tRNA charging and modification with translation factor residue modification
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation, tRNA wobble/wybutosine modification and modification of translation-associated proteins (eIF5A hypusine, eEF2 diphthamide, protein hydroxylation), unlike neighbours centred on termination/NMD, rRNA/tRNA processing or protein methylation.

qualifier: heart tube and second heart field
name: Early heart tube and second heart field development
rationale: Members concern mesodermal cardiac fate, heart tube morphogenesis, second heart field specification and cardioblast proliferation, distinguishing it from neighbours focused on septation, outflow tract, coronary vessels and ventricle formation.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
qualifier: sympathoadrenal neuron lineage
name: Neural progenitor proliferation with sympathoadrenal neuron development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell proliferation and asymmetric division plus noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion and adrenal development, which the midbrain, cerebellar and glial neighbours lack.

qualifier: connexin trafficking and connexon assembly and turnover
name: Connexin trafficking, connexon assembly and gap junction turnover
rationale: All members describe connexin oligomerisation, secretory and microtubule transport, gap junction regulation and annular internalisation, unlike neighbours on cardiac conduction or electrical transmission.

qualifier: de novo via IMP to AMP and GMP
name: De novo purine nucleotide biosynthesis via IMP
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP synthesis and its conversion to AMP, XMP and GMP, distinguishing it from purine salvage, pyrimidine synthesis and nucleotide catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: assembly, disassembly and non-mRNA cargo transport
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly, mitotic disassembly/reformation, localisation and transport of ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates and Rev cargo, unlike neighbours on SUMOylation, nuclear envelope reformation or mRNA export.

qualifier: endocytic recycling of vesicles and receptors
name: Synaptic vesicle and neurotransmitter receptor endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, active zone and synaptic cytoskeleton organisation and postsynaptic receptor internalisation/transport, unlike neighbours on vesicle docking/priming, plasticity or general endosomal recycling.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin and cation-chloride cotransporter
name: Vasopressin and cation-chloride cotransporter control of water-salt balance
rationale: Members span vasopressin/aquaporin renal water absorption, SLC12 cotransporter disorders, osmotic stress responses and sodium/potassium transport regulation, unlike neighbours on magnesium/paracellular transport or renin-angiotensin control.

qualifier: clathrin coat assembly and disassembly
name: Clathrin coat cycling in synaptic vesicle endocytosis
rationale: All members concern clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and regulation of clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, unlike neighbours on active zone structure, postsynaptic receptors or pigment granule coating.

qualifier: glycine/threonine degradation and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine-threonine catabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members cover threonine and glycine degradation and glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate in mitochondria, unlike neighbours on alanine/glyoxylate or proline metabolism.

qualifier: stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor regulation, RUNX1 programmes, erythrocyte and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation and myeloid progenitor signatures, unlike neighbours focused on granulocyte/monocyte differentiation or stem cell maintenance.

qualifier: prostaglandin and leukotriene synthesis and receptors
name: Prostaglandin and leukotriene synthesis and receptor signaling
rationale: Members span COX/prostaglandin and leukotriene biosynthesis, PLA2 arachidonate release and prostanoid/leukotriene GPCRs, unlike neighbours on lipoxins/HETEs, P450 epoxygenase or histamine.

qualifier: downstream kinase and transcriptional effectors
name: Neurotrophin TRK receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members are TRKA/TRKB downstream events (PI3K/AKT, p38, ERK5, CREB, RAC1, CDK5, NGF-stimulated transcription), unlike neighbours on p75NTR, receptor-proximal adaptors or ligand activation.

qualifier: morphogenesis of chambers, valves, septa and outflow tract
name: Heart morphogenesis of chambers, valves, septa and outflow tract
rationale: Members cover broad cardiac morphogenesis including myocardium, valves, septa, outflow tract, conduction system and coronary vessels, unlike neighbours on electrical coupling, vascular endothelial development or cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration.

qualifier: ADAR RNA editing, PKR and OAS
name: Type I interferon regulation by ADAR editing, PKR and OAS
rationale: Members concern ADAR A-to-I editing, PKR and OAS antiviral effectors and negative regulation of IFN-alpha/beta signaling, unlike neighbours on TLR or RIG-I nucleic acid sensing.

qualifier: medium-chain and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
name: Medium-chain and peroxisomal fatty acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover medium-chain fatty acid synthesis/catabolism, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA and peroxisomal beta-oxidation of pristanoyl and very long chain substrates, unlike neighbours on carnitine shuttle, ALD or alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: including bile acid synthesis and transport
name: Cholesterol, lipoprotein and bile acid metabolism and transport
rationale: Members span chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly and clearance, cholesterol regulation and bile acid synthesis, transport and signaling, unlike neighbours on triglyceride storage or xenobiotic/bilirubin transport.

qualifier: nuclear envelope and cytokinetic abscission
name: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and cytokinetic abscission
rationale: Members concern ESCRT-III-driven nuclear membrane resealing, midbody abscission and ESCRT disassembly, unlike neighbours on multivesicular body/viral budding or lamina depolymerisation.

qualifier: opioid and orexin GPCRs, wakefulness
name: Neuropeptide and opioid GPCR signaling, including orexin wakefulness
rationale: Members share neuropeptide and opioid G protein-coupled signaling with dense-core vesicle release and orexin-driven wakefulness, unlike neighbours on sleep, drug or stress behaviours.

qualifier: amyloid-beta and excitotoxic neuronal injury
name: Microglial activation and neurotoxicity in amyloid-beta and excitotoxic injury
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity with responses to amyloid-beta, kainate and hippocampal neuron death, unlike neighbours on amyloid clearance or apoptotic cell engulfment.

qualifier: clearance and fibril formation
name: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
rationale: All members concern clearance of amyloid-beta or formation of amyloid fibrils, unlike neighbours on APP processing, microglial activation or tangle assembly.

qualifier: fission, membrane potential and protein localization
name: Mitochondrial fission, membrane potential and protein localization regulation
rationale: Members promote fission/fragmentation and type 2 mitophagy, regulate membrane potential and localise proteins to mitochondria, unlike neighbours on PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, apoptotic MOMP or mitochondrial import machinery.

qualifier: germinal center, Tfh and plasma cell differentiation
name: B cell signatures and germinal center plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell, memory and plasma cell signatures with germinal centre formation, Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, unlike neighbours on B cell homeostasis, CD27 or BCR signaling.

qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake, efflux and SREBP-LXR control
name: Cellular cholesterol uptake, efflux and SREBP-LXR transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis and degradation, cholesterol efflux and SREBP/LXR-regulated sterol homeostasis, unlike neighbours on triglyceride-rich lipoproteins, ABCA1/phospholipid efflux or bile acid and intestinal absorption.
